items.question: Under what condition must a hundred-thousand count be placed at the site of god-worship after an act has been completed?
premises: An act must be completed before placement occurs.
A count of a hundred-thousand is assigned to a fixed location.
That location is defined as the site linked to god-worship.
items.inference: The completed act secures placement of a hundred-thousand at the god-worshipped forehead-syllable site.
uncertainties: Exact scope of the count remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having done the act, place a hundred-thousand at the forehead-syllable-mass site of the god-worshipped place.
